title: The Arrangement of Field Experiments
lineage: Inspected primary text or later historical source; see locator and qualification.

passages.locator: Journal of the Ministry of Agriculture 33, pp. 503–513, discussion of random arrangements and blocks
passages.note: Fisher’s 1926 article connected random plot arrangements and blocking with estimation of experimental errors in field comparisons. Random allocation and comparative experiments had earlier precedents. The article does not establish a first invention of randomization.
